description: Keyword metrics and research for App Store / Google Play search terms: popularity (5–100), difficulty (0–100), result count and the #1 result's estimated daily downloads. include adds related terms with metrics, the store's autocomplete and the current top 10 apps; app adds that app's rank and metadata relevance per term (the core of an ASO keyword audit). Unmeasured terms are measured live (a few per call) or come back pending. Keyword ideas: pass only app (no terms) to get the terms worth targeting for that app, best opportunity first: AI-checked for relevance (other apps' brand names and off-topic terms dropped), scored from popularity, difficulty and the app's rank, each with a reason. A new app's first call queues the research (a few minutes, not charged). Cost: 1 per keyword; 5 per seed with include=related or suggestions; 5 for keyword ideas (0 while pending) credits.

app.description: Any app identifier (as in `{app}`); adds `app.rank` and `app.relevance` per term. Alone (no `q` / `qs`) it returns keyword ideas for the app.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (storefront), e.g. us, gb, de. Default: us.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

include.description: related (~10 related terms with metrics), suggestions (store autocomplete), top_apps (current top 10). related/suggestions cost 5 credits per term

terms.description: Search terms, 1–25 (at most 5 with include related or suggestions). Omit, with app, for keyword ideas for that app

wait.description: Block up to ~25 s for a refresh (default). false = answer immediately from cache with a job id.

name: keyword_research
title: Keyword Research
